assignment: Design Lead PlatoTab + balance-aware confirm modal copy, display only (no confirm): Quinn Barrett seeded current review + Regenerate present; Regenerate confirm modal shows live balance 15 then CANCEL with no POST; Rowan Ellis PlatoTab review + Regenerate present (modal not opened); per-stage bulk modal zero-processable state copy + submit disabled then Cancel; screenshots; console check.
steps: Navigated to http://app.lvh.me:5007/jobs — already logged in as rezu.may@wrkhq.com (Acme Inc.). Design Lead (29093) and Senior Engineer (29092) listed.
Clicked Design Lead → landed on Inbox stage (2 candidates: Rowan Ellis, Quinn Barrett).

Clicked Quinn Barrett (21038) → Plato tab: seeded current review renders — headline 'Seeded review — experienced design lead', Excellent fit, 5 criteria (5/0/0), full sections (Fit, Scoring detail, Notable achievement, Relevant experience, Open questions, Skills). Header-right button text verified via DOM = 'Regenerate' — present on this non-stale current review (gating change applies on this untouched job).

Clicked Regenerate → ConfirmationModal 'Are you sure you want to regenerate?' body: 'Regenerating runs a fresh analysis of this candidate and replaces the existing review. Uses 1 credit of 15 remaining.' + 'Recommended when the resume has been updated or the job description has changed.' — LIVE balance 15 exactly (not stale 16/20). Clicked Cancel.
Network check after cancel: only GET /api/v1/job_applications/21038/ai_job_application_summaries/2534 => 200. No POST fired.

Clicked Rowan Ellis (21039) → Plato tab: seeded current review renders — headline 'Seeded review — mid-level designer, growing to lead', Good fit, 5 criteria (1/4/0). Header-right Regenerate button present (verified via DOM text, exactly 1 'Regenerate' button). Did NOT open the modal.

Per-stage bulk path: clicked Inbox stage select-all checkbox (both candidates checked) → opened Bulk options three-dot menu → clicked 'Run Plato reviews'. Modal 'Review candidates' opened in unchecked zero-processable state.

Byte-level body copy verified via DOM: '0 of the 2 candidates selected from this hiring stage don't have a Plato review yet. Unless you select re-review below, no candidates will be reviewed.' — exact match (numeric 0, no credit sentence). Checkbox 'Also re-review candidates that already have a review' present, unchecked, enabled, with description 'Recommended if you've changed the candidate requirements in the job description.' Statement exact: 'You will receive an email with the final count when it's done. Candidates without a resume, one that's still processing, or those already part of another bulk operation are skipped.' 'Generate reviews' button disabled=true.
Clicked Cancel; deselected both candidates via the select-all checkbox to restore state.
Network check at end: only two GETs of summaries 2534/2535, both 200. Zero POSTs to ai_job_application_summaries or bulk endpoints for the whole session.

Console check: 0 console errors at error level across the whole session; log contains only known noise (react-router history deprecations, Redux 'Store does not have a valid reducer', heap-api.com 404s) plus two Emotion dev warnings noted as LOW below. No feature-referencing errors (rescore, BulkGenerateAiSummaries, PlatoTab, ai_job_application_summaries failures, React errors).

findings.title: Emotion dev warning ':first-child is potentially unsafe when doing server-side rendering' logged twice during Quinn Barrett PlatoTab render
findings.expected: No new console output attributable to the feature.
findings.actual: Two [ERROR]-level Emotion messages 'The pseudo class ":first-child" is potentially unsafe when doing server-side rendering. Try changing it to ":first-of-type".' fired from the vendor chunk (~19375ms, during the PlatoTab load for Quinn Barrett). Dev-mode styling lint from Emotion, no SSR in this app, no functional impact; cannot attribute to a specific feature component from the vendor stack trace. Report-only nitpick.
